name: PT Indo Kordsa Tbk
summary: PT Indo Kordsa Tbk engages in the manufacture, marketing, and sale of tire cord fabrics, yarn filaments, nylon tire cord, and raw materials of polyester. The company operates through Tire Cord Fabric, Nylon Yarn, and Polyester Yarn segments. It also offers nylon, polyester, and rayon fibers. The company sells its products in Indonesia, Thailand, the United States, Japan, South Korea, Brazil, Turkey, India, China, and internationally. The company was formerly known as PT Branta Mulia Tbk and changed its name to PT Indo Kordsa Tbk in 2006. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Bogor, Indonesia. PT Indo Kordsa Tbk is a subsidiary of Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S.
